metadata.selection_criteria: Low barrier to entry, paid/commercial, general-purpose, suitable for a startup with no track record

findings.title: Bootstrap Strategy Overview
findings.summary: Build credibility on smaller platforms before approaching the big cloud marketplaces (AWS, Snowflake, Databricks, Google).
findings.details:
RECOMMENDED SEQUENCE

Week 1–2 (zero cost, immediate)
  Datarade       → List all data products (free, broad reach)
  Nomad Data     → Register + onboarding meeting (free, 100% revenue)
  Eagle Alpha    → List if any finance-relevant data (free)

Week 2–4 (low effort, build revenue)
  Dewey Data     → Submit partnership form (they do all the work)
  Opendatabay    → Upload + list datasets (self-service)
  Neudata        → List vendor profile (free)

Month 2–3 (build track record)
  Nasdaq Data Link → Apply if finance-relevant data exists
  Defined.ai       → Apply if AI-training-relevant data exists
  Data & Sons      → List as supplementary channel

Month 3+ (armed with credibility)
  Apply to Snowflake, AWS, Databricks, Google
  Cite Dewey/Datarade customers + transaction history
  Evaluate Monda for multi-marketplace management

findings.title: Dewey Data (formerly SafeGraph)
findings.summary: Curated marketplace that handles everything: sales, delivery, support, compliance. Strong precedent of onboarding small/single-founder providers. Listings live in <2 weeks.
findings.details:
MODEL: Curated two-sided marketplace. Dewey handles all sales, delivery, and support.
BARRIER: Low — partnership form, no engineering needed, listings live in <2 weeks.
REVENUE: Revenue share (% undisclosed). Monthly usage reports + citation tracking.
BUYERS: Academic institutions (MIT, Stanford, NYU, Berkeley, etc.)
CATEGORIES: Real estate, mobility, labor, consumer, corporate intelligence, government, financial, weather, technology.

SMALL PROVIDER EVIDENCE:
• LobbyingData.com — single founder
• NatureQuant — small ML + geospatial company
• Capology — niche football salary data
• ~30 total providers including RentHub, ClimateCheck, REsimplifi

ACTION: Submit partnership form at deweydata.io/partner-with-dewey

findings.title: Opendatabay
findings.summary: Open data marketplace focused on AI/LLM datasets. Self-service signup, set your own price, 5–30% commission with payouts within 30 days.
findings.details:
MODEL: Open marketplace. Self-service upload and pricing.
BARRIER: Very low — sign up, upload data, set price, list.
REVENUE: 5–30% commission (sliding scale). Payouts within 30 days.
BUYERS: AI/ML teams, researchers, analytics buyers.
CATEGORIES: General-purpose — AI, research, analytics, any data type.
REQUIREMENTS: Must be original creator or have rights to data.

ACTION: Sign up and list datasets immediately once ready.

findings.title: Data & Sons
findings.summary: "eBay of data" — open marketplace where anyone can list any dataset. Very low barrier. Reviews data for privacy compliance before publishing.
findings.details:
MODEL: Open marketplace — buy, sell, share any dataset.
BARRIER: Very low — anyone can list. Platform reviews for privacy compliance.
REVENUE: Transaction-based (details on signup).
BUYERS: General public, researchers, businesses.
CATEGORIES: Completely general-purpose.
FOUNDED: 2016 (Tampa, FL), launched 2017.

CAVEAT: Buyer pool may be smaller than enterprise platforms.

ACTION: List datasets as supplementary channel.

findings.title: Defined.ai
findings.summary: AI training data marketplace. Curated seller program with a high quality bar (30% acceptance rate). 65% revenue growth in 2025. ISO 27001, GDPR/HIPAA compliant.
findings.details:
MODEL: AI training data marketplace with curated seller program.
BARRIER: Medium — application required, only 30% of applicants approved.
REVENUE: Revenue share (details on acceptance).
BUYERS: AI/ML companies, enterprises, tech innovators.
CATEGORIES: Speech, text, image, video, multimodal — any AI training data.
GROWTH: 65% revenue growth and 1,200% marketplace expansion in 2025.
COMPLIANCE: ISO 27001/27701, GDPR, HIPAA.

ACTION: Apply if data products can be positioned for AI training use cases.

findings.title: Nasdaq Data Link (formerly Quandl)
findings.summary: Curated marketplace with strong brand credibility. Nasdaq handles sales to ~950K financial professionals. Selective (~250 premium datasets). Application-based onboarding.
findings.details:
MODEL: Curated two-sided marketplace. Nasdaq handles sales and distribution.
BARRIER: Medium-high — application + quality review. Selective (~250 premium datasets total).
REVENUE: Revenue share (% undisclosed). Nasdaq sells on your behalf.
BUYERS: ~950K financial professionals (hedge funds, asset managers, quant researchers).
CATEGORIES: Financial/alternative data: economic indicators, geospatial, sentiment, ESG, commodities.

SMALL PROVIDER EVIDENCE:
• Sharadar — independent research firm, successful small provider

CAVEAT: Only for datasets with clear financial/investment relevance. Highly selective.
VALUE: Nasdaq brand association = very strong credibility signal for cloud marketplace applications.

ACTION: Apply via nasdaq.com/solutions/data/alternative/monetize-your-data

findings.title: Datarade
findings.summary: B2B data directory with 2,600+ providers and 120K+ monthly visitors. Free to list, commission only on closed deals. 500+ categories. Self-service.
findings.details:
MODEL: B2B data directory/marketplace. Buyers express interest, Datarade connects them to you. You handle the sale.
BARRIER: Very low — self-service listing, SEO-friendly profile page, KYC verification.
REVENUE: Commission on closed deals only (% undisclosed). Free to list.
BUYERS: 120K+ monthly visitors. B2B enterprises across all sectors.
CATEGORIES: 500+ categories. Completely general-purpose.
PROVIDERS: 2,600+ listed including many small/niche companies.

NO REASON NOT TO LIST — zero cost, broad reach, SEO presence + inbound leads.

ACTION: List immediately at datarade.ai/company/contact/list-your-data

findings.title: Nomad Data
findings.summary: AI-powered matching platform. Zero fees, zero commission — providers keep 100% of revenue. 2,500+ data sources. Buyers search anonymously; you choose which leads to engage.
findings.details:
MODEL: AI-powered matching. Buyers search anonymously; providers choose which leads to engage.
BARRIER: Low — free to list. Requires initial onboarding meeting.
REVENUE: Zero fees, zero commission. Negotiate directly with buyers, keep 100%.
BUYERS: Enterprise data buyers.
CATEGORIES: General-purpose across all industries.
PROVIDERS: 2,500+ data sources listed.
FOUNDED: 2020 (NYC).

ACTION: Register and complete onboarding meeting.

findings.title: Eagle Alpha
findings.summary: Alternative data aggregator since 2012. Free vendor profiles, zero commission, direct introductions to institutional investors. Also provides compliance consulting and pricing help.
findings.details:
MODEL: Alternative data aggregator. Free vendor profiles. Direct buyer introductions.
BARRIER: Low — free listing, no commission.
REVENUE: Zero fees, zero commission. Also provides compliance consulting + pricing strategy help.
BUYERS: Institutional investors (hedge funds, asset managers).
CATEGORIES: Alternative data: geospatial, web, transaction, ESG, sentiment, economic.
PROVIDERS: 2,500+ data products listed.

CAVEAT: Data must have investment-relevant signal. But free to list = no downside.

ACTION: List if producing any data with investment/financial relevance.

findings.title: Neudata
findings.summary: Independent data scouting platform. Free listing, no commission, no revenue sharing. Vendors report an average of 19.8 qualified buyer introductions per year.
findings.details:
MODEL: Data scouting platform. Connects vendors with qualified buyers. Independent (no conflicts).
BARRIER: Low — free listing, no commission.
REVENUE: Zero fees, zero commission, zero revenue sharing.
BUYERS: 1,000+ qualified data buyers (investment firms, corporates).
CATEGORIES: Alternative + traditional data.
PROVIDERS: ~2,000 vendors listed.
RESULTS: Average 19.8 qualified buyer intros per year per vendor.
FOUNDED: 2016.

ACTION: List alongside Eagle Alpha for maximum financial-sector visibility.

findings.title: Monda
findings.summary: "Shopify for data products." Create listings once, syndicate to Databricks, Google Cloud, SAP Datasphere, Datarade and more from a single account. 500+ companies use it.
findings.details:
MODEL: Multi-marketplace distribution hub. Create listings once, syndicate everywhere.
BARRIER: Subscription plan (pricing not public). Designed for DaaS startups.
REVENUE: You keep your revenue; Monda charges a platform subscription.
SYNDICATION: Databricks, Google Cloud, SAP Datasphere, Datarade, and more.
USERS: 500+ companies.

Does not store your data — listings point to your own storage.
No engineering required.

STRATEGIC VALUE: Solves the multi-marketplace management problem once you have 5+ data products across multiple platforms.

ACTION: Evaluate once ready to scale across cloud marketplaces.
